findings.concern: vendored Rust exports could be mistaken for linked endpoints
findings.resolution: the reader admits only rustzcash exports with a digest-identical build mirror and the explicitly declared rollup Rust archive symbol witness.

findings.concern: callback types could fabricate reverse edges
findings.resolution: callback files are retained as MAY_TOP(callback_receiver_set_not_proved), with no target or graph writer.

findings.concern: user descriptors could enable name-only matching
findings.resolution: descriptor validation requires recognised witnesses and artifact_symbol for every connector.

accepted_limits: The archive proves an endpoint export, not a C wrapper, OCaml caller, full ABI or final loaded image.
Only the declared rollup archive is included in this first Rust connector.
